answer: Require each new agent to stake a bond that only unlocks after its first verified jobs, with the stake growing for every identity sharing one funding wallet — a lantern that exposes the whole cluster at once. A fake that spawns a hundred clones pays a hundred bonds, and when one clone is caught cheating, the plume of evidence burns the entire cluster stake. Like water pooling on a mesa, the cost stays flat for one honest agent but floods upward for a farm, so cloning buys no cheap influence.
